company.name: AutoStream
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that provides automated video editing tools for content creators. We help YouTubers, Instagram creators, and TikTok influencers save time with AI-powered video editing.
company.mission: Empowering content creators to focus on creativity while we handle the editing

policies.refund_policy: We offer a full refund within 7 days of purchase. After 7 days, no refunds are available. You can cancel your subscription anytime, and it will remain active until the end of your billing period.

support.basic_plan: Email support available during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM EST, Monday-Friday)
support.pro_plan: 24/7 priority support via email, chat, and phone

policies.trial: We offer a 14-day free trial for both plans. No credit card required to start your trial.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription anytime from your account dashboard. No cancellation fees apply.
policies.data_retention: Your projects and data are retained for 30 days after cancellation, allowing you to reactivate without losing work.

features.ai_editing: Our AI automatically detects key moments, removes silence, adds transitions, and optimizes pacing for maximum engagement.
features.ai_captions: Automatic subtitle generation in 50+ languages with 95%+ accuracy. Available on Pro plan.
features.batch_processing: Upload multiple videos and let our AI edit them simultaneously. Pro plan only.
features.cloud_storage: Secure cloud storage for all your projects. Access from anywhere, collaborate with team members.
features.export_formats: Export in multiple formats optimized for different platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.)

faq.question: What platforms do you support?
faq.answer: AutoStream works with all major content platforms including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Twitch. Our AI optimizes videos for each platform's specific requirements.

faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade to Pro anytime and get immediate access to all features. If you downgrade, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

faq.question: Do you offer annual billing?
faq.answer: Yes, annual billing is available with a 20% discount. Contact our sales team for annual pricing.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We offer a 14-day free trial for both Basic and Pro plans. No credit card required to start.
